_note: Scenarios for E3-03 (effective level). They verify hard rules 3.5 (three separate sources, nivel_efectivo = highest of the valid ones) and 3.6 (synchronous promotion, nightly demotion). Dates are relative to `hoy` (today). Thresholds come from the niveles rule in reglas-validas.json (Plata 500, Oro 1.500, Diamante 3.000, confirmed by the client). Source fields use the database column names.

event_rules._note: Client decisions of 2026-10-10 (issue #9). Mirrored in config/niveles.php; a test asserts they match.

matricula_colegio._note: Level by the number of valid enrollments. Each enrollment brings its own end date.

cases._description: Customer who is Oro by points and Diamante by a valid membership: the effective level is Diamante.
cases._e3_03_criterion: oro by points + valid diamante membership = diamante

cases._description: When the membership expires, the same customer falls to Oro (their points level), not to Bronce.
cases._e3_03_criterion: when the membership expires they fall to oro, not bronce

cases._description: Synchronous promotion: the customer crosses the Oro threshold (1.500) with a purchase; when the request ends their effective level is already Oro.
cases._e3_03_criterion: synchronous promotion in the same request

cases._description: Protection: the balance falls below the Oro threshold, but inside the protection window the nightly evaluation does NOT lower the level. Only possible when the rule's proteccion_meses is above 0.
cases._e3_03_criterion: inside protection the nightly evaluation does not lower

cases._description: Demotion: after the protection period, the nightly evaluation lowers to the level the balance gives and records the change with its date.
cases._e3_03_criterion: after protection the nightly evaluation lowers and records the change

cases._description: Zero-month protection (current client decision): the balance falls below the Oro threshold and the next nightly evaluation lowers the level right away.
cases._e3_03_criterion: with proteccion_meses 0 the drop happens on the next nightly evaluation

cases._description: Property purchase gives Diamante while valid, even if the points say Bronce.
cases._e3_03_criterion: a valid event wins over points

cases._description: Two properties do not add up levels: still Diamante, valid until the latest end date.
cases._e3_03_criterion: several events of the same kind do not add up; validity is the latest end date

cases._description: Two valid school enrollments give Oro.
Three valid school enrollments give Diamante.
One of three enrollments is closed (the child left the school): on the next nightly evaluation the event level goes back to Oro.
cases._e3_03_criterion: closing one of three enrollments goes back to oro

eventos.motivo_cierre: El niño se retiró del colegio

cases._description: Hard rule 3.6 barrier: no code path lowers the level inside an HTTP request (it only goes up or stays).
cases._e3_03_criterion: no HTTP request lowers the level
cases.exception: only the nightly evaluation may lower it
